findings.message:
[P2] Preserve follow-latest intent after hidden renders

When capacity data is rendered while the Analytics section is hidden, the zero-width guard leaves `capacityChartFollowsLatest` true but the replacement scroll node remains at its default `scrollLeft` of 0. On the first visible resize render, this line treats that default left edge as a real user position when the chart overflows, flips the intent to false, and restores the chart toward the oldest edge instead of the newest. Keep the hidden-render intent until a visible position has actually been established.

static/admin.js:2196-2196

summary: The queued-scroll fix works for a visible chart, but it loses newest-edge intent when a chart was rendered while Analytics was hidden.

evidence: `static/admin.js:2195-2203` derives `capacityChartFollowsLatest` from the same visible scroll measurement that computes `anchorAtMs`.
`static/admin.js:2186-2187` and `2207-2209` retain the zero-width hidden-render guards.
`tests/admin-capacity-status.test.ts:125-154` adds a focused refresh-before-scroll-event anchor-preservation check.
